title: Kerala South: Madurai → Vagamon → Varkala → Alleppey → Wayanad

Madurai.desc: Madurai is a major tier II city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is the cultural capital of Tamil Nadu and the administrative headquarters of Madurai district, which is governed by the Madurai Municipal Corporation established on 1 November 1866

Varkala.desc: Varkala, historically known as Balita is a coastal municipality and a northern suburb of Thiruvananthapuram, the capital city of the Indian state of Kerala.

Wayanad.desc: Wayanad district, or Wynad, is a district in the north-east of the Indian state of Kerala, with its administrative headquarters at the municipality of Kalpetta. It is the only plateau in Kerala. The Wayanad Plateau forms a continuation of the Mysore
